title: Tread-Life Reading and the Life-of-Tread Refund
content:
A recent routine tread reading of the covered set bears on the refund of a cancelled Crestline Road Hazard Life-of-Tread Protection certificate refunded on the Life-of-Tread cancellation refund.

**The reading.** The reading used is the covered set's most recent Crestline routine tread inspection with an even wear pattern, as recorded on the set's Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty history. Its age is the whole calendar months from the inspection date to the cancellation.

**Usable-tread share.** The reading less the plan's coverage tread limit (2/32 inch on the Life-of-Tread plan), divided by the tire line's original tread depth less that same limit.

**Life-of-Tread tread-life factor.** When the most recent routine reading is fewer than 6 whole calendar months old and its usable-tread share is at most 0.2, the Life-of-Tread unused share is multiplied by 0.7 in the prorated amount; when such a recent reading has a usable-tread share above 0.2 and at most 0.4, it is multiplied by 0.9; otherwise it is multiplied by 1.

| Most recent even-wear reading | Usable-tread share | Multiplier on the unused share |
|---|---|---|
| fewer than 6 whole months old | 0.2 or less | 0.7 |
| fewer than 6 whole months old | above 0.2, up to 0.4 | 0.9 |
| fewer than 6 whole months old | above 0.4 | 1 |
| 6 or more whole months old, or none on file | — | 1 |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical line of 10/32 inch new tread).** The usable span is 8/32. A reading of 3/32 gives a share of 1 of 8, that is 0.125, multiplier 0.7. A reading of 4/32 gives 0.25, multiplier 0.9. A reading of 5/32 gives 0.375, multiplier 0.9. A reading of 6/32 gives 0.5, multiplier 1. A reading of 3/32 taken 6 whole months before the cancellation: multiplier 1.
